sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Offshore Trade Intermediary and Commercial Re-Invoicing Operations

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Panama General Corporation Law (Ley No. 32 de 1927), as amended, Articles 1 through 72; supplemented by the Panamanian Commercial Code provisions applicable to Sociedades Anónimas.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá, Sección de Sociedades Anónimas – Miches, Panama City.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima (notarized Public Deed of Incorporation).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; authorized capital is set out in the deed and may be subscribed without immediate payment or escrow deposit. The subscriber must receive at least one issued share.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION NO. 1 OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME], S.A.
The Board unanimously resolves:
1. Share Subscription. The subscribers' undertakings to acquire the initial issued shares are approved, and the Share Register is authorized.
2. Registered Office. The registered office is fixed at [Panama City address], and the Resident Agent named in the Articles of Incorporation is confirmed.
3. Officers. [Name], [Name], and [Name] are appointed President, Secretary, and Treasurer, each with full banking, signing, and management powers for re-invoicing operations.
The Secretary is directed to register this resolution and to file all tax and municipal operation notices. Approved unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Search and Availability Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Dirección de Registro de Empresas and online Panamá Emprende portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a preliminary name search and obtain the official 'Certificado de Búsqueda de Nombre' for the selected corporate name; confirm that no conflicting or identical Sociedad Anónima is registered; reserve the chosen name and secure the right to use it in the notarial deed.
required_dossiers: Three proposed corporate names in order of preference
Engagement letter with the resident agent or founding solicitor
Identity details of the incorporators and initial directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name search returns similarity or identity with an existing company, submit the next alternative name and obtain a fresh availability certificate; no other administrative objection is typical in this step.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública in Panama City, Republic of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución) and bylaws, including corporate name, authorized capital, share classes, registered office address, resident agent, initial directors and purpose; present all incorporators or their accredited attorneys-in-fact before the Panamanian notary, who verifies identity and capacity; execute and notarize the deed and request certified copies for subsequent registry filing.
required_dossiers: Certificate of name availability from the Public Registry
Passport or national ID copies of all incorporators, directors, and subscriber officers
Resident Agent acceptance letter
Registered office lease or authorization letter from the property owner
Initial share allocation schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary rejects or queries any clause, execute an addendum or amended deed prior to signature; within 30 days re-present revised documentation and pay the corresponding notarial charges.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration at the Public Registry and Corporate Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Sociedades Anónimas, Miches
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed and notarized Escritura Pública de Constitución together with all required evidentiary dossiers to the Public Registry corporate section; pay the official registry fee and applicable corporate stamp tax; await the registration entry and issuance of the certificate of incorporation; the Sociedad Anónima acquires legal personality only upon entry in the Public Registry.
required_dossiers: Original notarized Escritura Pública de Constitución
Certified copies of the deed
Proof of payment of registry and stamp fees
Resident Agent acceptance certificate
Certificate of name availability
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a 'reparo' (defect notice), correct the cited inconsistency and file the clarification within the statutory response term; if the term lapses, re-present the deed and request an extension before the same registry section.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration and Operation Notice (RUC and Aviso de Operación)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of Panama – SURI platform and Ventanilla Única de Inversiones (VUPA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After corporate registration, open the SURI electronic portal, register the company as a taxpayer, and obtain the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC); file the Aviso de Operación application selecting the general trade/re-invoicing activity (ISIC rev. 4 code 4690) and the applicable territorial income tax regime; after validation, obtain the municipal commercial operation clearance from the Municipality of Panama.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation issued by Registro Público
Certified copy of the notarized deed
Company RUC application form completed in SURI
Officer and resident agent identity documents
Proof of registered office address and local operation address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI requires additional economic-activity evidence, supply the ISIC correlation and a brief business description; if the application is rejected, correct the RUC classification online, pay any minimal late fee, and resubmit in SURI.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Ultimate Beneficial Ownership Registration and Annual Compliance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Registro de Beneficiarios Finales platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within the statutory deadline after incorporation, submit the initial beneficial ownership declaration identifying every natural person holding at least 10% direct or indirect interest or control; confirm the resident agent and registered office record; set up annual corporate governance filings, accounting records retention, and UBO update alerts to maintain good standing.
required_dossiers: RUC certificate and corporate folio number
Share register and shareholder identity documents
UBO declaration form signed by each ultimate beneficial owner or attorney-in-fact
Directors' and resident agent contact details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the beneficial ownership declaration is queried, correct the shareholding chain in the share register and file an amended UBO declaration; if repeated rejection occurs, present a formal DGI reconsideration letter within the prescribed appeal period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No sectoral industrial licensing board applies to non-industrial re-invoicing trade; general commercial operation licensing is coordinated through MICI (Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias), the Municipality of Panama, and DGI via VUPA.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación de Empresa (Business Operation Notice) and municipal Permiso de Operación Comercial; no sectoral statutory license is mandated for the general re-invoicing activity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE), Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Not Listed – office-based commercial re-invoicing operations do not trigger an Environmental Impact Assessment or a preliminary environmental report under the Panamanian environmental categories.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, combustion, or VOC emission sources are generated by re-invoicing operations; compliance is limited to ordinary municipal solid waste management, safe electronic-waste disposal, and connection to municipal sewer or approved sanitation facilities under the General Environmental Law (Law No. 41 of 1998).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety inspection and clearance from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá for the commercial office; municipal building occupancy/structural-load verification for the leased premises; MITRADEL (Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral) workplace health and safety registration if employees are engaged.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Directorate of Revenue (Dirección General de Ingresos, DGI) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance, Republic of Panama; official digital portal: https://www.dgi.gob.pa / e-Tax platform: https://etax.mef.gob.pa.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must appoint a resident legal agent (abogado) and file the notarized and apostilled corporate documents with the Public Registry of Panama. After the company registration (Ficha) is recorded, the agent submits the DGI 'Solicitud de Inscripción de Contribuyente' form, together with corporate by-laws, appointment of directors and legal representative, and proof of a Panama address. The DGI then issues the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente), which includes the ITBMS registration. The S.A. must also obtain a municipal business patent (Aviso de Operación) from the corresponding Municipality.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope: the Panamanian S.A. is subject to entity-level income tax solely on Panama-source income; foreign-source income derived from re-invoicing transactions with non-resident buyers is generally outside the income tax net and is not subject to Panamanian corporate income tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or US-style entity classification election exists under Panamanian law. All commercial S.A. entities are taxed as corporations under a territorial model. Available elective statutory regimes for re-invoicing trade include: Multinational Company Headquarters (SEM) agreement under Law 41 of 2007; Panama Pacifico Special Economic Area tax incentives; and registration as a 'Sociedad de Inversión' under Law 18 of 2019 for holding and dividend rationalization. Hybrid mismatch elections are not provided under Panamanian law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS) — Panama’s value-added tax (VAT) system.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover-based registration threshold: any person habitually carrying out taxable transfers of goods or services must register as a responsible ITBMS taxpayer in Panama from the commencement of activities. A small-taxpayer simplification (cuota fija) is available for persons with annual gross income not exceeding PAB 36,000 (USD 36,000), but a professional re-invoicing S.A. is expected to be a standard registered taxpayer.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing through DGI’s 'Facturación Electrónica' system. Authorized invoice service providers (PSFE) submit every invoice to DGI for validation before the invoice reaches the buyer; each invoice carries a DGI validation code (código de seguridad) and a QR code. Export invoices must be discriminated as zero-rated or non-subject and matched to the customs declaration. Non-integrated paper invoices are accepted only by authorised small taxpayers; registered S.A. re-invoicing entities must use the e-invoice clearance regime.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A zero rate applies under ITBMS when the title to goods is transferred with physical export from Panamanian territory or where services are provided to a non-resident recipient wholly outside Panama. For commercial re-invoicing trades, the Panamanian entity may issue an invoice for an offshore delivery to a foreign buyer only if the transfer is supported by (i) a written contract evidencing export sale, (ii) proof that the goods left Panamanian customs jurisdiction, or (iii) documentary evidence that the service/economic use occurred abroad; if goods remain outside Panama and never enter Panamanian territory, the transaction is non-subject rather than zero-rated, but must still be documented.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Aduanera de Exportación, DAU/DUE)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (principal transport document)
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT/FX credit evidence from the receiving bank
Commercial Invoice and signed packing list
Certificate of origin/platform registration where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI scrutinizes zero-rating claims against DAU filings, transport documents, banking receipts, and the counterparty’s non-residence. If export zero-rating is claimed without legal substantiation, the ITBMS becomes due retroactively with statutory late-interest, a fine of up to 100%–300% of the omitted tax, and, where fraud or false documents are involved, criminal tax evasion sanctions of up to 10 years’ imprisonment. Any refunds already obtained may be clawed back with penal interest and loss of future export/refund incentives.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama does not operate a central bank and has no monetary authority exercising discretionary exchange-rate policy. The Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) supervises banking institutions and enforces AML/CFT compliance; the Banco Nacional de Panamá functions as a state-owned financial institution and fiscal agent, but not as a lender of last resort. The Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas coordinates fiscal policy. The U.S. dollar is legal tender; the Panamanian balboa is a subsidiary unit circulating only as coins at par with the dollar.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates a fully dollarized economy with complete capital and current account convertibility. There are no exchange controls, no central bank permission for foreign-currency transfers, and no restrictions on inward or outward capital movements for non-resident-owned entities engaged in re-invoicing or offshore trade intermediation. Profit remittances, dividend distributions, and repayment of intercompany loans may be made freely in USD or any convertible currency. The practical hurdles to profit remittance are not exchange-control barriers but bank-level AML/KYC compliance: the entity must evidence source of funds, underlying trade transactions, tax filings, and beneficial ownership. Dividends from Panamanian corporate income are subject to the applicable territorial dividend tax regime; however, distributions attributable to genuinely offshore-source re-invoicing operations may carry reduced Panamanian tax exposure subject to legal analysis and documentary support.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Panama imposes no statutory surrender, repatriation, or mandatory conversion requirement for export proceeds. A Panamanian exporter or trade intermediary may hold foreign-currency receipts abroad or in local bank accounts in USD or other currencies without obligation to exchange them into balboas. The SBP's AML/CFT rules and banks' internal policies require that export proceeds be credited only against documents evidencing the underlying export transaction, and certain transaction thresholds may trigger reporting to the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF). Excessive delays in settlement, unusual debtor patterns, or repeated invoice mismatches may prompt enhanced due diligence but do not constitute FX surrender obligations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and LC Issuance Facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium for offshore digital EMI providers. Panama's banking law grants deposit-taking authority exclusively to entities licensed by the SBP; a non-resident electronic-money institution without a Panama banking license cannot lawfully maintain client funds or operate local settlement accounts for a Panamanian S.A. Such EMIs may be used as auxiliary payment interfaces if they route transactions through an SBP-licensed bank or a licensed payment processor, but they cannot serve as the primary liquidity/clearing rail. A Panama-licensed fintech or payment services company is viable only after obtaining the relevant license and establishing local compliance infrastructure, making this path slower and less reliable than a Tier 1 bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, initial account opening for a non-resident-owned S.A. engaged in re-invoicing requires physical presence of at least one director or the appointed compliance officer, or acceptance of remote opening only where the bank has an existing client relationship and the documents are notarized and apostilled. Mandatory personal interview: most Tier 1 banks require a face-to-face interview with the signatories and beneficial owners during onboarding for medium-risk re-invoicing structures. In rare cases, banks with digital onboarding capabilities may permit a video interview with a notary or correspondent bank certifying identity, but physical or video presence remains a non-waivable KYC requirement. All corporate resolutions, passport copies, and registry abstracts must be current and apostilled where required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership with opaque beneficial ownership structure or nominee shareholding.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the sociedad anónima public registry extract (Registro Público de Panamá), certificate of good standing, complete share register or transfer ledger, formal declarations of ultimate beneficial owners with valid passports, signed directors'/officers' questionnaires, and two professional bank reference letters.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Re-invoicing model with high-volume invoice flows and no goods physically entering Panama.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master resale and purchase agreements, original commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading/airway bills, inspection certificates, customs filings, logistics contracts or warehouse receipts showing where goods are shipped, and a written economic-substance memorandum demonstrating actual management and trade administration in Panama.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transactions involving jurisdictions on FATF/OECD watchlists, sanctions programs, or countries with weak AML enforcement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Jurisdictional risk matrix showing legal and reputational risk, sanction screening results for all counterparties, beneficial-owner nationality and residency proof, documented commercial rationale, tax clearances from the relevant jurisdictions, and confirmation that no sanctioned party is involved.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large, unexplained, or rapid round-tripping of funds through related-party or intercompany accounts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Group organizational chart, intercompany loan and trade agreements, treasury policy, projected cash-flow statements, audited or certified financial statements, Panamanian territorial tax filings, bank statements from originating accounts, and a funds-flow mapping memo tracing each payment to its specific underlying invoice.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injections are routed by SWIFT MT103 to the named Panama operating account. Although Panama imposes no exchange-control approval or government permit, the receiving bank requires the wire to include in Field 70 a clear purpose narrative such as 'Equity contribution to PA_CORP' and an accompanying board resolution, subscription agreement, share certificate, and source-of-funds evidence from the remitter. Banks will treat the funds as capital in foreign investment only upon receipt of full KYC documentation; amounts above internal thresholds may be subject to enhanced scrutiny and prepared UAF reports (e.g., suspicious transaction report thresholds). The account must be understood as receiving only cleared funds; no pre-account credit is available to new corporate accounts.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade payments for purchased goods to suppliers are executed primarily through SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers. Bank-to-bank liquidity transfers use MT202/MT202COV where necessary. For import settlements, a commercial letter of credit opened by a Panamanian bank is transmitted via SWIFT MT700 with subsequent MT707 amendments; sight or usance drafts are drawn under the LC and paid through the confirming or advising bank. Local USD clearing can be done through the Panamanian clearing house for same-day domestic payments, but cross-border payments must rely on correspondent banking relationships, normally through U.S. bank correspondents. Transactional compliance requires the same invoice alignment, customs documentation, and trade justification as used for onboarding; all payments should be made only to pre-vetted counterparties listed in the beneficiary database.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX spot contracts in major liquid currencies (EUR, GBP, CHF, CNY) entered into with SBP-licensed banks
Deliverable FX forward contracts up to 12 months with documented underlying trade exposure for re-invoicing operations
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for restricted or less liquid currencies where the trade payable/receivable is invoiced in such currency
FX swaps and cross-currency swaps between USD and major convertible currencies for term-smoothing of treasury cash flows
Plain vanilla FX options for hedging anticipated trade-related receivables or payables, provided the bank documents the commercial purpose

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax / Corporate Maintenance Fee Filing (Tarifa Anual de Sociedad Anónima)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance; remitted through the licensed resident agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year cycle: 1 January - 15 March for USD 300; after 15 March, the payment increases to USD 400 and remains payable until 31 December; not based on the incorporation anniversary.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic USD 100 late surcharge (total USD 400); the corporation loses good standing and cannot obtain a Paz y Salvo / certificate of good standing; the Registro Público may deny registrar processing; prolonged non-payment may initiate administrative strike-off/dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada Anual del Impuesto sobre la Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fiscal year-end basis: by 31 March for calendar-year taxpayers; within three months after close of a different adopted fiscal year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines and monthly interest under the Código Fiscal; possibility of administrative collection action and tax criminal proceedings for fraudulent non-filing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No blanket statutory audit for an S.A. under Law 32 of 1927. Independent CPA audit required when (a) the corporation's bylaws/articles mandate it; (b) gross annual revenue reaches the DGI's audit threshold (generally USD 3,000,000 or as updated); (c) banking, insurance, securities, or AML regulations require it; or (d) DGI orders a special audit/examination.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS/NIIF as endorsed in Panama; IFRS for SMEs available for non-public-interest entities; the DGI also accepts financial statements prepared on a Código Fiscal tax basis for non-audit-bound filers.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 23 of 2015, the licensed resident agent must maintain a Beneficial Owner Register (Registro de Beneficiario Final) and obtain an annual (calendar/anniversary) written confirmation from the board of directors as to all share transfers, the identity of each shareholder of record, and the chain of ownership leading to every ultimate beneficial owner. Any share transfer must be evidenced by an endorsed share certificate, transfer instrument, or board resolution, and recorded in the Share Register before it is effective against the company; the resident agent must update the UBO register within 30 calendar days after a change and may not certify or file a document until the updated register is complete.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Ultimate Beneficial Owners (Registro de Beneficiario Final)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 - USD 750 per year for standard licensed resident agent and registered office service
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 - USD 5,000 per audit engagement when the audit threshold is triggered; USD 0 for a non-audited offshore S.A. not meeting the threshold

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard corporate income tax rate on Panamanian-source net taxable income; taxpayers with annual gross income not exceeding PAB 1,500,000 pay 15% on the first PAB 50,000 of taxable income and 25% on the excess)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation: foreign-source income (goods, title, services and payment events occurring outside Panama) is excluded from the taxable base, producing an effective 0% rate on offshore re-invoicing margins; statutory incentives include the SEM multinational headquarters regime (Law 41 of 2007), Colon Free Zone and Panama Pacifico concessions, Ciudad del Saber exemptions, and targeted deductions for tourism, reforestation and agro-industrial activities; effective rates on qualifying incentivized activities can range from 0% to 5% for up to 10 years

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2710 (Declaración Jurada de Impuesto sobre la Renta – Personas Jurídicas) filed electronically through the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) e-Tax platform of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, accessible at https://dgi.mef.gob.pa using the entity's RUC
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 90 days (3 months) after the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers, the statutory filing deadline is 31 March of the following calendar year; no general extension exists

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ingresos brutos de fuente panameña (gross income derived from Panamanian source: local sales, local performance, title transfer in Panama)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only income connected to activities performed in Panama; a non-resident-owned re-invoicing S.A. that never transfers title or performs services inside Panama reports nil here

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ingresos de fuente extranjera no gravados (foreign-source income excluded under the territorial system)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare all offshore re-invoicing revenue in this box where purchase and onward sale contracts, delivery, risk and payment occur outside Panama; retain purchase orders, bills of lading, SWIFT payment evidence and the contract chain

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total ingresos brutos (aggregate gross receipts before deductions)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Sum of Box 101 and Box 102; for a purely offshore re-invoicing hub this equals the full turnover passing through the Panamanian invoice

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costo de ventas y gastos directamente asociados (cost of goods sold and directly attributable costs)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Match invoiced turnover with the third-party or related-party purchase cost; for offshore pass-through trades deduct the supplier invoice amount paid from the Panamanian account

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Renta neta gravable (net taxable profit after statutory deductions)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nil where Box 102 carries all income and Box 201/other deductible costs exhaust the margin; ensure no Panamanian-source operational expenses are claimed against exempt foreign-source profit

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Impuesto calculado and creditable prepayments (calculated CIT at 15%/25%, monthly advance payments, and third-party withholding tax credits)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the progressive 15%/25% schedule only to Box 101-derived profit; credit Form 2705 advance payments and any local WHT certificates; a foreign-source-only S.A. reports zero tax, zero credits, and requests no refund

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Saldo a pagar o saldo a favor (final tax payable or overpayment carried forward/refunded)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Output the net settlement amount; the non-resident entity must ensure the payment is linked to its RUC and the annual filing before expiry of the statutory deadline

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and late payment trigger an automatic surcharge of 10% of the tax due plus 2% monthly surcharge for each month or fraction of delay, capped at 24 months, together with 1.5% monthly interest on arrears under Tax Code articles 730 et seq.; administrative fines range from PAB 100 to PAB 5,000; repeated non-filing exposes officers to criminal tax-evasion proceedings under Law 70 of 2019

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Monthly advance payment scheme (pagos a cuenta) executed through the DGI e-Tax electronic payment module using Form 2705 and related payment vouchers
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the 15th day of each calendar month in respect of the immediately preceding month's gross taxable income; applies to taxpayers whose prior-year gross income exceeded PAB 1,500,000; smaller taxpayers are generally excluded

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Base del anticipo (advance base): 2% of monthly gross taxable Panamanian-source income, or the optional prepayment method based on the prior year's CIT liability
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report nil where the re-invoicing S.A. derives only foreign-source income; no monthly advance is required on offshore exempt turnover

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholding tax certificates and prior-month overpayments credited against the advance installment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign-source-only entity will have no local WHT certificates; file the nil monthly declaration solely to maintain DGI clearing status if the taxpayer profile requires it

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-payment or late payment of monthly advances accrues 1.5% monthly arrears interest and 2% monthly surcharge on settlement, with final reconciliation and true-up on Form 2710; concealed Panamanian-source income in the advance base is treated as under-withholding and may trigger the criminal fraud sanctions
